policy: Task qualification labels were not changed. Intermediate results from the affected scorer/acceptance implementations are superseded and are not used as labels.

records.issue: An input could make operation A not execute while still yielding a vacuous masking relation.
records.old_behavior: The first scorer version could return WITNESS_VERIFIED for MSMS/MMBS on the bind task with input {} even though A never ran.
records.correction: MSMS/MMBS now require sys.settrace confirmation that A executed; MSMS additionally requires a nonempty MMBS witness of a real local effect.

records.issue: Three implementation defects were found while building the independent path.
records.old_behavior: Subset ids were expanded into character lists; a target path was compared as jinja2/loaders.py instead of src/jinja2/loaders.py; whitespace or line layout affected code comparison.
records.correction: Use sorted operation-id lists, source-dir-relative paths, and whitespace-normalized token comparison. All five tasks were accepted again from scratch.

records.issue: The first trace attempt set PYTHONPATH only to the kit, so Werkzeug test imports failed and Jinja2 could import an installed package instead of the copied tree.
records.old_behavior: Werkzeug returned pytest exit code 4; Jinja2 tests passed but did not execute the copied A line.
records.correction: Prepend the copied project's src/ to PYTHONPATH and run a fresh copy per task.
